Current monthly net rent is CHF1800; the landlord maintains the fixed central heating and circulation pump. The lease requires usable heated living rooms in winter.

The defect persists at this report's as-of time; no lasting pump repair or replacement has been completed. Heating is inadequate for the contracted winter residential use of the principal living rooms.

On 2025-02-21 at07:30, a calibrated digital instrument (calibration check2024-12-15, uncertainty±0.2C) measured the living room at15.8C after overnight normal operation. Main living rooms stayed15.5–16.3C in the seven-day logger record. Resets restore heat briefly; the pump cuts out repeatedly.
